mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past three months signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is below 102 (index 2017=100), the current level signals an economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 102.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 280 (index 1982-1984=100), persistent inflation pressures lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 280.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 640,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS < 640000.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 650,000 million dollars), a further increase in retail sales signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 650000.
